Bounding box only — this is one integrally-molded arch stone (voussoir lines are decorative engraving, not separate pieces), the closest fit to this catalog's shapeType enum

Bounding box only — closest available shapeType is "prism" (this catalog has no dedicated pyramid/column category yet, see the sets.rs GKNF0 entry's note)
